summary: Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on July 22, 2026. The company sold 11,500,000 units at $10.00 each, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option, raising $115 million in gross proceeds. Concurrently, it privately placed 239,300 units to its sponsor at $10.00 per unit for $2.393 million. Net proceeds of $115 million were deposited into a trust account. This is a routine SPAC IPO announcement, not a special-situation corporate event, and involves no acquisition, tender, or restructuring. The filing is primarily administrative, disclosing the IPO closing and the trust deposit, with an audited balance sheet attached as an exhibit.
